sources.entry: piqueserver - Server for openspades, the first-person shooter in a destructible voxel world. (Clients) GPL-3.0 Python/C++

summary.one_liner: piqueserver is a Python-based dedicated server for Ace of Spades 0.75, the voxel first-person shooter, forked from PySnip.
summary.what_it_does: It runs a multiplayer Ace of Spades 0.75 game server with administrator tools, a large set of chat commands, and map rotation. Maps can carry metadata (name, version, author, configuration) and extensions such as water damage. It includes a map generator, a remote console over SSH, an IRC client for managing the server, a JSON query webserver, and a status server with a map overview. Gamemodes include deathmatch and runningman, and it supports server and map scripts. The README also lists gameplay extras such as airstrikes, pickaxe melee, dirt grenades, spectator mode, platforms with buttons, rollback to the original map, and a ban subscribe service.
use_cases: host an Ace of Spades game server
run a voxel shooter multiplayer server for friends
administer players and bans on a game server
rotate custom maps on a game server
manage a game server remotely over SSH or IRC
write server-side scripts for game modes
notable: Continuation of the PySnip project for keeping Ace of Spades servers running
Docker support and multiple config directories, per the README FAQ
Remote administration console over SSH and IRC client for server management
Built-in map generator and map metadata/extensions system
Optional extras for SSH manhole and IP geolocation via the from command
caveats: The README says the AUR git package is currently broken
Targets Ace of Spades 0.75 only; 0.76 support is planned for the future only
Prebuilt builds are listed only for Linux x86_64 and Windows; other systems need a C++ compiler
